source: The reviewed catalog (`reviewedCatalogDatabase`, archived in .archive/scripts/listing-domain-check-v1-import.ts by #315 and rebuilt with the live publisher and migrations, both unchanged since): the fresh apps/web/drizzle migrations, the checksum-verified v1 import (.archive/d1/artifacts/best-serp-co-v1.sql.br), then every committed d1/publications manifest that adds or removes categories, unpublishes listings, or retires categories, in file order.
Live: status approved and is_active 1. Listings unpublished by a committed manifest are not live there, so none is in this inventory.

Not remote D1: staging and production may differ (admin decisions, approved submissions and edits since). Each manifest operation guards the listing's categories (`expected`), so a listing that changed refuses its batch.

fields.listings: Live listings filed under the category, primary or secondary (what the category page and index count).
fields.primaryListings: Live listings whose primary category it is.
